languages.name: Java
languages.tagline: Core Java → Advanced Java. 120 concepts — professional path, honest coverage.
languages.description: The global one-stop Java roadmap split into Core Java and Advanced Java. Core Java takes you from your first semicolon through OOP, collections, generics, and professional fundamentals. Advanced Java covers modern language features, concurrency, JVM internals, frameworks, and production systems. Free for every developer worldwide — JDK 21 LTS.
